integrity: Exact integer enumeration through the proven regularity cutoff 10 is reproduced by verify.py. No independent audit claimed. The dated 2010-03-29 original arXiv posting (arXiv:1003.5444v1) is the earliest day-resolved preprint record verified for supporting graph edge-polytope literature. The older Ohsugi--Hibi (1998) first-public date could not be resolved to a calendar day; no journal publication date was used as a surrogate.
scientific_limitations: The explicit monomial supports and symmetry are the only proposed additional contribution. Cohen-Macaulay type 11, the h-polynomial and almost-Gorensteinness already follow from Hatasa--Kowaki--Matsushita (2024); no novelty is asserted for those. The canonical ideal has a selected monomial equivariant structure, not a canonical claim about all geometric linearizations. Independent historical priority and full syzygies remain unverified.
title: An explicit symmetric canonical ideal for the Petersen edge toric variety
